description: Location corrections found during gym-information research batch 5 (non-metro gyms, part 1): 64 gyms whose pin was far from the official address (often another town) or whose address was missing. Address from the official site; pin from the OpenStreetMap element for the gym, a house-number geocode of the official address, or the official site's own place coordinates (named per record); checked 2026-10-04. Names, suburbs and type tags are not changed here.
